title: Covariant derivatives (vectors and tensors)
objective: Implement covariant derivatives nabla_I v^J = ∂v^J/∂θ^I + Γ^J_{IK} v^K (and the corresponding rank-2 version) in the symbolic layer so that rate-form constitutive models and the UL tangent can operate on curvilinear fields correctly.

plan_assets.asset_description: B2.3 covariant derivative formula for a contravariant vector.

scope: Add `covariant_derivative_vector(v, christoffels, theta)` and `covariant_derivative_tensor_rank2(T, christoffels, theta)` helpers.
Support both contravariant and covariant index positions.
Symbolic path; no backend codegen in this task.
implementation_steps: Implement the formulas directly with SymPy, keeping index positions explicit in function names.
Unit-test on a radially-symmetric field in cylindrical coordinates where the closed form is known.
Unit-test that on Cartesian coordinates the covariant derivative reduces to the partial derivative.
acceptance_criteria: Covariant derivative of a radially-symmetric velocity field in cylindrical coordinates matches the hand calculation.
On Cartesian coordinates, covariant derivative equals the partial derivative.

cases: Contravariant vector covariant derivative on cylindrical
Covariant vector covariant derivative on cylindrical
Rank-2 tensor covariant derivative on cylindrical

risks: Index-gymnastics bugs are easy. Mitigation: use named index variables ('I', 'J', 'K') in the test assertions to make position mismatches visible.
completion_notes: All 3 gates passed first attempt. Formulas verified for all 3 index positions (contravariant, covariant, rank-2).
